resources.string: A gentle wave that flows while music plays
The whole song\'s loudness in soft layers
Loudness as slim bars, the lightest on battery
A thick glowing ribbon with a pearl cap
Dots sized by the music that swell around the thumb
A level meter of lit blocks that follows the loudness
One smooth ridge drawn from the song\'s loudness
A fine thread with a bead at every minute
A glass tube filling with liquid that ripples to the beat
Applies right away. Motion runs only while music plays.
